en.heroBody: A five-star motoring experience, from your first message until the car is returned.
statementTitle: A journey cared for from end to end
en.statementBody: Every vehicle is owned and cared for directly by us. No brokers, and no hand-off of your experience to another provider.
en.chooseBody: Choose for the occasion and the way you want to travel—not simply for the badge.
en.processBody: A dedicated concierge guides every step—no long forms required.
processNotes: Choose the car that suits your occasion and journey.
Verify your identity with your concierge, usually within 15 minutes.
Receive the car at your home, hotel or airport at the agreed time.
en.demo: Concept fleet and pricing shown for demonstration.

zh.heroBody: 五星级用车体验，从首次咨询到车辆归还，全程由专属礼宾团队照料。
zh.statementEyebrow: 自营 · 精选 · 悉心养护
zh.statementBody: 每一辆车均由我们直接拥有并悉心维护。没有中间商，也不会把您的服务体验转交给第三方。
zh.chooseBody: 根据场合与出行方式选择座驾，而不只是追随品牌标志。
carNotes: 为重要夜晚准备的顶级后排舒适体验。
从容易驾、性能澎湃的豪华旅行座驾。
兼顾城市驾驶与动感体验的均衡之选。
zh.processBody: 专属礼宾全程协助，无需填写冗长表格。
processNotes: 选择适合场合与行程的座驾。
通过专属礼宾完成身份核验，通常仅需15分钟。
按约定时间在家中、酒店或机场接收车辆。
zh.demo: 页面中的车辆与价格均为概念演示信息。
